title: Luscious Smoky Syrian Pork Kebabs
description: A smoky and molten Syrian dish featuring pork shoulder, perfect for a crowd, cooked on a salt block and served with double-rise-bread
instructions: Preheat the salt block to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube
Place the skewers on the preheated salt block and cook for 10-12 minutes per side
While the pork is cooking, toast the double-rise-bread cubes on the salt block
Once the pork is cooked, serve with the toasted bread and a side of your choice
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before serving
Garnish with fresh parsley or oregano, if desired
